final_message:
The September 2026 draft for Bluebird Bakery is written, with the "DRAFT" banner still on it, and saved in `evals/runs/v4-run-20261013/c_bb_subtotal_mismatch/skill_output/`:
- `bluebird-bakery-co-2026-09-trends.md`: the report, with 8 commentary bullets I wrote in section 1
- `bluebird-bakery-co-2026-09-trends.json`: all the figures, as computed by the skill's script

**Data quality: one mismatch.** In March 2026, the subtotal "Total for Professional Services" says 2,225.00, but the accounts under it add up to 2,200.00 (25.00 apart). The report uses the 2,200.00 from the individual accounts, and the reviewer needs to decide which figure is right. The commentary opens with this. Two other parts of the sheet had to be pieced together:
- "Total Delivery" has no heading row, so it was grouped from Delivery Van Fuel and Courier: Same Day.
- "Charitable Donations" has no total row, so it was treated as an empty account.

**Main points:**
- **Revenue was 81,300**, up 17.7% on August (69,050) and 17.3% above the average of the previous 6 months (69,292). There are no year-over-year or trailing-12-month figures because the export only covers 9 months (Jan–Sep 2026).
- **Wholesale Accounts is a new revenue stream:** 12,000 in September and zero in every earlier month. Whether it will recur is for the reviewer to confirm. Pastry Sales fell month over month in every month from April to September.
- **Gross margin was 65.3%**, up 5.7 points from August and the highest month in the export.
- **Costs:** Payroll & Benefits rose 5,000 (+28.4%) to 22,600, and Wages & Salaries alone went from 16,000 to 21,000. Total operating expenses rose 21.0% to 31,570. The bank balance fell to 37,600, down 10,800 over six months, even though the business made a profit every month. The reviewer may want to look into why.

Mystery Shopper Program shows as rising "from 0" in the movers table. It was also 400 in March and June, so I described it as a line that looks quarterly rather than a new cost.

**Accounts left in "Other":** Instagram Ads, Mystery Shopper Program and Supplier Rebates matched no category rule. Supplier Rebates is a credit (-250 in September).
